# stb_image

`stb_image.h` v2.30 from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit
`f58f558c120e9b32c217290b80bad1a0729fbb2c`, unmodified. Licence: MIT or
public domain (the reader's choice, see the end of the file); listed in
docs/licenses.md.

Used by `host/render/src/slang_chain.cpp` to decode the PNG lookup textures of
slang shader presets (docs/specs/shader-stacks.md). Only PNG is compiled in.
